features.name: Carnahan–Jackson Memorial Garden
features.source: User reference photograph and red bridge/three-pool description, 2026-09-13; Chautauquan Daily 2026-08-16 and 2017-08-26/27 locate Carnahan–Jackson Garden southwest of Amphitheater, along Brick Walk beside Park Place. Saved Esri aerial and mapped paths constrain placement. Internal arrangement, planting and dimensions are photo-based approximations. User correction 2026-09-13: entrance stairs descend from the path immediately beside the Amphitheater. The public path stays at grade; the garden pocket and connecting flight are lowered. Exact stair dimensions and garden depth are visual approximations.

features.name: Clark Brick Walk along the east edge of Bestor Plaza
features.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/20047299
features.note: Plaza-side route, left of the bookstore/cafe promenade in the review image. Red brick verified in located Google Street View and georeferenced Esri aerial. Existing OSM centerline preserved; 3.2 m width estimated from aerial, not surveyed. Continues to the existing Clark/Odland brick surface at Miller Avenue. Northern end trimmed to the rendered Ames Avenue/parking-bay grass-side curb, per supplied 2026-09-14 screenshot.
